## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard today? (e.g. "When debugging a
stuck consumer, I can't see …")

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches or workarounds you've thought about.

## Additional context

Mockups, links to how other tools do it, or any other context.
